native_review.summary: The agent successfully authenticated Sofia Li using name and zip code, located her delivered camera order (#W4689314), identified the only available 10x (maximum) zoom variant, accurately explained that no available 10x variant preserved her exact 24MP/SD specs, obtained explicit confirmation including confirmation that all items were included, and processed the exchange via her PayPal account. The exchange was completed correctly with accurate pricing. No user errors were found; the user provided only known/derivable information and appropriately confirmed the chosen option after the agent verified no spec-identical 10x alternative was available. Minor agent policy deviations were noted: making four tool calls in one turn while also messaging the user (TURN 8), giving subjective comments ('great upgrade', 'perfect for your bird-watching') in TURNS 15 and 21, and making an ungrounded claim about there being no expedite option in TURN 17. None of these affected the final outcome.

errors.reasoning: The agent made four get_order_details tool calls in a single turn and also included a user-facing message in the same turn. The policy explicitly states the agent should make at most one tool call at a time, and should not respond to the user while making a tool call (or vice versa).
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made only one tool call at a time, waiting for each tool response before proceeding, and should not have written to the user in the same turn as a tool call.

errors.reasoning: The agent said 'this would be a great upgrade for bird-watching!', which is a subjective recommendation/comment. The policy explicitly prohibits giving subjective recommendations or comments.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have presented the factual details of the exchange without subjective commentary such as 'great upgrade'.

errors.reasoning: The agent claimed 'there's no separate expedite option available for exchanges'. This is a procedural/factual claim about the company's processes that is not grounded in any tool result or user-provided information, violating the policy not to make up information not provided by the user or tools.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should not have asserted the nonexistence of an expedite option without tool or policy support; it should have limited its response to what it can confirm or process.

errors.reasoning: The agent ended with 'perfect for your bird-watching!', which is a subjective comment about the exchanged product. The policy prohibits giving subjective recommendations or comments.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have confined the closing message to factual exchange details and a neutral offer for further assistance.

auth_classification.reasoning: The agent successfully authenticated the user by looking up the account using the provided name (Sofia Li) and zip code (78260), and confirmed the user's identity before proceeding with the exchange.
